text:
maria: Dropped a prototype for the Prompt Sets page focusing on density options + the approval flow copy. Link in the drive. Quick gut-check please: is the compact list readable? does the approval modal convey risk clearly? :eyes:

devin: Compact list reads fine at 1280 width but the callouts collapse too aggressively on 1024. Can we make the secondary metadata wrap instead of hiding it?

ash: +1 on wrapping metadata. Also noticed the change badge uses only color to indicate severity (minor/major). Need a textual cue for colorblind users e.g., M/S prefix or verbose label.

kieran: For the approval modal, current primary button says "Approve" and the secondary is "Approve with comment" which is confusing. Proposal: Primary = "Approve for production", Secondary = "Request changes" and tertiary = "Approve with comment" hidden under menu.

sam: Accessibility check: the inline results table doesn't announce row count when filters are applied. Screen reader users might miss that the diff set is smaller after filtering. Suggest `aria-live="polite"` region with "Showing X of Y prompts".

maria: Good catch sam. Also, can we add a tiny preview of the top diff in the modal before final confirm? A one-line summary like "Removed placeholder text in prompt 4" would help accidental approvals.

devin: For compact density toggle, instead of persistence in settings, can we persist per-user per-project? People toggle density frequently per workflow. Cookie or user pref should work.

ash: Microcopy: change the toast after approval from "Applied" to "Prompt set approved — changes live in production" and include Undo link. Keep undo for 20s.

kieran: Keyboard nav: when modal opens, focus goes to close button. Prefer focus on primary action so keyboard users can confirm quickly, but still provide a visible focus trap. Also Esc should close modal and not submit.

sam: Export CSV: include a `diff_summary` column with plain text. For large exports we should truncate and add a `full_diff_url` column.

uxbot: Accessibility audit note generated: A11Y-109 (diff labels), A11Y-110 (aria-live summary), A11Y-111 (modal focus), A11Y-112 (diff text in CSV).

maria: Action list I'm capturing: 1) Metadata wrapping on narrow widths (devin) 2) Add text labels to severity badges (ash) 3) Approval CTA reorder + preview line (kieran + maria) 4) aria-live row counts (sam) 5) Persist density per-user (devin) 6) Toast copy + undo 20s (nash) 7) CSV diff_summary + full_diff_url (sam). I'll open tickets and mark a11y ones as blocker for GA.

devin: I'll do the responsive tweak and drop a small Figma frame. kieran can you review the modal order?

kieran: Yep will review and post comments. Thanks folks.
